answer_1.quote: We collected three new datasets for benchmarking detection of AI-generated text across the domains of creative writing, news, and student essays. For each of the three datasets, we collected ChatGPT-generated text corresponding to the human-authored text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated stories, news articles, and student essays

answer_4.quote: We collected human annotations to validate the difficulty of our datasets and provide a human baseline. Six undergraduate and PhD students ... were given a random set of 50 documents, evenly sampling human-authored and AI-generated documents, and asked to label whether the documents were written by a human or AI.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each document as either human-authored or AI-generated.
